name: barcelona-fps
description: Barcelona FPS — shooter en primera persona en la manzana de la Sagrada Familia (Babylon.js)

scripts.test: npm run test:interp && npm run test:server
scripts.build:prod: npm run build && node scripts/precompress.mjs dist && npm run build:server
scripts.build:sagrada: node scripts/icgc-index.mjs && node scripts/icgc-fetch.mjs 75 150 && node scripts/icgc-to-glb.mjs public/assets/buildings/sagrada-familia.glb --rot 45 --cx 8 --cz 8 --cy 31 --box -54,-54,54,54 --ground 0 --above 1.3 --bright 1.15 --gamma 1.9 --tex 1024
